meta.methodology: Immediate outgoing tangent of the first nonzero actual mapped track segment at the departure anchor. Use the downstream mapped platform extent where available; otherwise use a mapped stop position, or a station coordinate projected onto actual tracks for that line. At a vertex use its following outgoing segment; inside a segment use its downstream remainder. No distance averaging, station-to-station bearing or invented track segment is used.

referenceMethods.platform-end: Outgoing track tangent at the downstream end of the mapped platform.
referenceMethods.stop-position: Outgoing track tangent at the mapped train stop position.
referenceMethods.station-projection: Outgoing track tangent at the station position projected onto the mapped service track.

limitations: Records describe measured departures by station, line, direction and branch; they are not a count of distinct physical platforms.
A null platform means the public platform number is unassigned. Optional platformCandidates are mapped possibilities, not an assigned platform.
Track bearings are map-derived estimates, not surveyed measurements or live train headings.
